chapters.label: Greeting & Introduction
chapters.summary: Agent welcomes the customer and introduces the hotline.

chapters.label: Problem Statement
chapters.summary: Customer explains their interest in organic certification programs due to rising fertilizer costs.

chapters.label: Investigation & Discussion
chapters.summary: Agent explains program requirements, eligibility, and application process for organic certification.

chapters.label: Options & Explanation
chapters.summary: Agent details additional programs, including equipment loans and grants, and their application methods.

chapters.label: Resolution & Next Steps
chapters.summary: Agent provides in-person support options, deadlines, and follow-up timelines for applications.

chapters.label: Upsell/Offer
chapters.summary: Agent introduces the Sustainable Inputs Grant for organic compost and fertilizers.

chapters.label: Closing
chapters.summary: Agent confirms email details for sending a summary and offers additional resources before ending the call.
